disease_label_per_paper: Candida glabrata severe urinary sepsis with candidemia successfully treated with micafungin
presentation_summary: Poorly controlled type 2 diabetic woman with six days of high-grade fever, dysuria, opalescent urine, and no response to ciprofloxacin.
Admission showed altered mental status, fever 39.2 C, tachypnea, tachycardia 124/min, hypotension 90/56 mmHg, dehydration, pyuria, leukocytosis, renal failure, severe hyperglycemia, and leukocyturia.
Blood and urine cultures later grew Candida glabrata resistant to fluconazole; fever and candidemia cleared after micafungin.
